question: Which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: Pseudopodia in amoeba helps in the formation of cells.
The egg of a hen is a group of cells.
WBC is an example of a single cell.

solution:
The correct answer is __**WBC is an example of a single cell.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Leukocytes or leucocytes** are other names for **white blood cells.**
 
• These** immune system cells** work to defend the body from** both infectious diseases** and invading **external invaders.**
 
• All white blood cells are created and developed from** hematopoietic stem cells,** which are **multipotent cells** found in the **bone marrow.**
 
• White blood cells all have **nuclei.**
 
• WBC cells are **unrestricted single-cellular organisms**.
 
• They **move independently** and take the desired things.
 
• These cells move in a** manner reminiscent** of the **amoeba, a unicellular organism.**
 
• Unlike amoeba and paramecium, they have** no natural tendency** to split apart and **reproduce themselves.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** functions of pseudopodia **in amoeba include **locomotion and ingestion**.

 
 
• Pseudopodia play a key role in **detecting objects** that can later be ingested.
 
• **Phagocytosis pseudopodia** are the engulfing pseudopodia. 
 
 
 
• The** single cell **that makes up an **edible hen's egg **is made up of** both protein and fat.** 
 
 
• The **division of the single cell** results in the **development of the embryo.**
 
• It causes the** egg to develop** into a chicken.
 
 
 
• Even while** most cells resemble spheres,** not all of them are spherical.
 
 
• The** spherical lymphoblastic cells **develop normally in suspension without adhering to a surface.
